questions.question: India Dispatches First Tranche of Humanitarian Aid to Myanmar Under ‘Operation ___________’
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Brahma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India Dispatches First Tranche of Humanitarian Aid to Myanmar Under ‘Operation Brahma’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Operation Brahma**: Launched by **India** to provide **relief** after a **7.7-magnitude earthquake** struck Myanmar and Thailand.

 
 
• 
 
**Myanmar** is located in **Southeast Asia** and shares borders with **Bangladesh, India, China, Laos, and Thailand**.

 
 
• 
 
The **capital** of Myanmar is **Naypyidaw**, and its **official language** is **Burmese**.

 
 
• 
 
The **official currency** of Myanmar is the **Kyat (MMK)**.

questions.question: By which year does India aim to achieve 500 gigawatts of non-fossil fuel-based energy capacity?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2030.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India's non-fossil fuel-based energy capacity has reached 217 GW, marking significant progress in solar and wind energy.**
 
• The nation has committed to achieving **500 GW of non-fossil fuel-based energy capacity by 2030**.
 
• Solar energy forms 47% of the total renewable capacity, with Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Tamil Nadu leading in solar installations.
 
• Gujarat, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu accounted for 98% of new wind capacity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **India's non-fossil fuel capacity target:** 500 GW by 2030.
 
• **Current capacity:** 217 GW from various non-fossil sources (solar, wind, hydro, nuclear, etc.).
 
• **Leading states in solar:** Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Leading states in wind:** Gujarat, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu, making up 98% of new wind capacity additions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Renewable Energy in India**__

 __
 
• India’s transition to clean energy focuses heavily on solar and wind, supported by government incentives and private sector investments.
 
• The overall goal is to reduce carbon emissions and meet global climate commitments.
 
 
 
• **Non-Fossil Fuel Sources**__
 
 
• In addition to solar and wind, non-fossil fuels include hydro, nuclear, and other emerging clean technologies.
 
• The increased capacity aids in reducing dependence on coal, improving air quality, and enhancing energy security.

questions.question: What is the name of the art exhibition that took place at the India in Bahrain Festival 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India Through My Eyes.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The *India in Bahrain Festival 2025* featured the art exhibition *‘India Through My Eyes’*, showcasing 42 paintings by 20 artists.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The second edition of the *India in Bahrain Festival* was organized by the Indian Embassy in collaboration with Lulu Hypermarket Bahrain and Dana Mall.**
 
• Indian Ambassador *Vinod K. Jacob* inaugurated the festival on February 21, 2025.
 
• Over 2,000 visitors attended, experiencing cultural performances, art, handicrafts, and Indian cuisine.
 
• The event is part of the *Promotion of Cultural Ties with Diaspora (PCTD)* initiative by the Ministry of External Affairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Promotion of Cultural Ties with Diaspora (PCTD)**__

 __
 
• A Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) initiative to strengthen India’s cultural connections with the global Indian diaspora.
 
• Encourages participation in festivals, exhibitions, and community programs worldwide.
 
 
 
• **India in Bahrain Festival**__
 __
 
• An annual event showcasing India's rich cultural heritage through art, dance, and food.
 
• Brings together Indian community associations to celebrate traditions and promote tourism.
 
 
 
• **Lulu Hypermarket’s Role**__
 
 
• Key partner in organizing the event and promoting Indian businesses in Bahrain.
 
• Facilitates trade relations between India and Bahrain through retail and commerce.

questions.question: Which country is invited to WAVES 2025 by India?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Chile**__.

• India invites Chile to participate in WAVES 2025.

questions.question: Which monuments in Karnataka have been proposed for UNESCO’s World Heritage tentative list?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakkundi Monuments.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Karnataka's Lakkundi monuments, from the Kalyana Chalukya period, have been proposed for UNESCO’s World Heritage tentative list.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakkundi's key structures include the Kasi Visvesvara and Manikesvara temples, with stepwells integral to the temple complexes.**
 
• The monuments showcase a blend of architectural styles: Nagara, Dravida, and Bhumija, integrated into the Vesara style.
 
• This proposal reflects the historical and architectural significance of the monuments from the Kalyana Chalukya period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List__

 __
 
• The Tentative List is the first step in the process of nominating a site for inclusion in the World Heritage List, which recognizes cultural and natural heritage of outstanding value to humanity.
 
 
 
• Lakkundi Monuments__
 
 
• Lakkundi, a historic town in Karnataka, is known for its well-preserved Chalukyan architecture and ancient temples.

questions.question: In March 2025, India launched 'Operation Brahma' in response to which event?

options.text: A major flood in northeastern India
A cyclone affecting the eastern coast of India
A volcanic eruption in the Andaman Islands

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A devastating earthquake in Myanmar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Operation Brahma** was launched by India in March 2025 as a humanitarian mission to assist Myanmar following a **devastating earthquake.**
 
• The earthquake caused widespread destruction in Myanmar, impacting thousands of lives and infrastructure.
 
• India, under its **"Neighbourhood First Policy,"** swiftly responded with relief efforts, showcasing its commitment to regional cooperation and disaster management.
 
• The operation included the deployment of rescue teams, medical aid, and essential supplies to assist affected communities.
 
• India’s National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) and other agencies played a critical role in the success of Operation Brahma.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Neighbourhood First Policy:**

 
 
• India’s foreign policy framework that prioritizes relations with neighboring countries to enhance regional cooperation and development.
 
• Emphasizes economic integration, cultural ties, and mutual assistance in times of need.
 
 
 
• **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF):**
 
 
• A specialized force in India established for disaster management under the Disaster Management Act, 2005.
 
• Equipped and trained to handle natural and man-made disasters, including earthquakes, floods, and industrial accidents.
 
 
 
• **India-Myanmar Relations:**
 
 
• India and Myanmar share a 1,643 km-long border and have strong cultural, historical, and economic ties.
 
• India has consistently supported Myanmar during crises, strengthening bilateral relations.
 
 
 
• **Earthquake Preparedness:**
 
 
• Measures include building earthquake-resistant infrastructure, conducting regular disaster preparedness drills, and promoting public awareness.
 
• India’s efforts in assisting Myanmar highlight the importance of international cooperation in disaster management.

questions.question: With which neighboring country did India sign an MoU to train 1,500 civil service officers over five years?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Lanka.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India and Sri Lanka have signed an MoU to train 1,500 Sri Lankan civil service officers over five years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The training program will be conducted by India’s National Centre for Good Governance (NCGG) and Sri Lanka’s Institute of Development Administration (SLIDA).**
 
• The MoU was signed in December 2024 during Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake’s visit to New Delhi.
 
• A delegation led by NCGG Director General Dr. Surendrakumar Bagde visited Sri Lanka to finalize the implementation process.
 
• The first batch of 40 Sri Lankan officers will undergo training soon, with a total of eight training modules planned annually.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• National Centre for Good Governance (NCGG)__

 __
 
• An autonomous institution under the Government of India focusing on capacity building and governance reforms.
 
• Provides training programs for civil servants from India and neighboring countries.
 
 
 
• Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration (SLIDA)__
 __
 
• The premier training and development institution for Sri Lankan civil service officers.
 
• Partners with international organizations to enhance administrative efficiency.
 
 
 
• India-Sri Lanka Bilateral Cooperation__
 
 
• Strengthening ties in governance, trade, and defense.
 
• India has previously trained over 200 Sri Lankan officers at NCGG.
 
• This initiative reinforces India's commitment to capacity-building in South Asia.

questions.question: Which country signed the agreement to establish the BIMSTEC Energy Centre in November 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India signed an agreement to establish the BIMSTEC Energy Centre in Bengaluru.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India signed an agreement to establish the BIMSTEC Energy Centre in Bengaluru, aimed at improving inter-grid connectivity among member nations.**
 
• The agreement was signed by MEA Secretary Jaideep Mazumder and BIMSTEC Secretary-General Indramani Pandey.
 
• The deal seeks to enhance cooperation in energy and infrastructure among BIMSTEC countries.
 
• **BIMSTEC includes Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Thailand, with its secretariat in Dhaka, Bangladesh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• BIMSTEC__

 __
 
• **Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation**, aimed at enhancing cooperation among member countries in various sectors including energy.
 
 
 
• Energy Centre__
 __
 
• A key initiative under BIMSTEC to enhance energy security and inter-grid connectivity among member nations.
 
 
 
• Inter-grid Connectivity__
 
 
• The process of linking electricity grids of different countries to improve energy security and reliability.

questions.question: ​The "Operation Hawk" was in the news. What is it about?

options.text: An anti-terrorism operation led by the Indian Army and Assam Rifles, targeting illegal poppy cultivation in the northeastern states of India.
A mission by Indian Navy to conduct surveillance in the Indian Ocean Region.
A government initiative aimed at promoting digital literacy among rural populations.
A CBI operation that dismantled international cybercrime networks involved in online child sexual exploitation.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**: __A Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) operation that dismantled international cybercrime networks involved in online child sexual exploitation. __ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)** successfully dismantled international cybercrime networks involved in online child sexual exploitation through **Operation Hawk 2025**, following actionable intelligence from US authorities. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **International Collaboration**: Operation Hawk was launched based on intelligence from the US, with CBI collaborating with international agencies to target cybercriminals exploiting minors across borders.
 
• **Arrests and Charges:** Two accused, Sheik Muizz Ahmed (Mangalore) and Mukul Saini (Delhi), were arrested and charged under the Indian Penal Code, the Information Technology Act, and the POCSO Act.
 
• **Significance and Impact:**
 
 
• **Global Law Enforcement Cooperation:** The operation underscores the importance of transnational cooperation in tackling cyber-enabled child sexual exploitation.
 
• **Strengthening Child Protection:** Building on previous operations like Operation Carbon (2021) and Operation Megh Chakra (2022), Operation Hawk reinforces India’s commitment to protecting children online.
